# Passport framing reference

Fictional AI-generated portrait created with the built-in image generation tool. Not an official passport-authority sample or an applicant photo.

Final prompt: Keep the same fictional person, white background, level front-facing pose, natural colors, lighting, no glasses and neutral expression. Enlarge the head so hair and chin are fully visible with approximately 83% hair-to-chin height, keeping only the top shoulders at the bottom. Maintain a 7:9 portrait aspect ratio. No text, arrows, or watermark.

Used as a visual example only; the app labels approximate framing and the limits of acceptance checks.

## Wider framing revision

Created with the built-in image generation tool. Prompt: Preserve the same fictional man, front-facing level pose, open eyes, neutral expression, navy shirt, white background and even lighting. Widen the framing so the entire chin, some neck, and tops of both shoulders are clearly visible. Keep hair and chin in frame, with breathing room above and beside the hair. Extend the shirt naturally to the bottom edge. No inset border, text, guides or watermark.
